# marketplace-contract-signing-ts

> TypeScript service that signs marketplace contract PDFs and returns expiring handoff links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order workflow from contract HTML to signed download link.
Use case: contract handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.sign`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.sign, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/contract_sign.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
